_notes: Import from Admin → Products → Import. Each object creates or updates a tour by `code`.
Prices are in OMR (major units). Lists use arrays here and pipe-separated values in the CSV template.
category_key must match an existing category key (city_tours, day_trips, multi_day, desert_4x4, mountain_wadi, cultural, food_family, boat, hiking_camping, photography, transfers, custom).
destination_keys must match existing destination keys (muscat, nizwa, wahiba, jebel_akhdar, salalah, musandam, sur, wadi_shab).
pricing_model is one of per_person, per_group, tiered, per_vehicle. An unknown value is rejected, and a row with status "published" must carry a complete price.
tiered: tier_first_adult_omr (total for one adult), tier_first_two_adults_omr (combined total for two), tier_extra_adult_omr (each further adult), tier_extra_child_omr (each child). Infants are free.
per_vehicle: vehicle_price_omr (flat per 4WD), vehicle_max_adults (default 4), vehicle_seats (default 6, children included). capacity_per_slot then counts vehicles per departure.
